respuesta.pregunta: For payment-promise-gateway 0.0.10-test-crc-migration, which endpoints does the API expose, and what HTTP response codes can each endpoint return according to its OpenAPI spec?
respuesta.respuesta:
In 0.0.10-test-crc-migration the API is documented with OpenAPI/Swagger, and these are its main endpoints: `GET /payment_promise/form`, `GET /payment_promise/active`, `GET /offers`, `POST /payment_promise`, `POST /forgiveness_proposal`, `PUT /forgiveness_proposal` and `GET /forgiveness_proposal/{promiseId}` [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L104-L112].

I can't tell you the response codes for each endpoint. The OpenAPI spec isn't part of these docs. The README just points to specs-hub for the detailed API documentation [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L114]. The only thing it says about errors is that the service uses HTTP status codes for API responses [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L530-L533]. It doesn't list which codes each endpoint returns. You'll need to check the spec in specs-hub for that.
